note: White-axis component equals absolute geographic difference in coarse white photo-label frequency; total variation TV = white-axis component + residual nonwhite composition. Source-conditioned vertex-null statistics use 199 permutations and species-equal means. Five-source cohort contrasts are post hoc; not independent providers.

result.inference_ceiling: geographic sorting of photographed colour labels only; not genetic population structure or dispersal history
result.quality_rule: assigned ROI >=65%, all competing coarse groups <=20%; not morph validation

notes_addendum: Only 127 high-purity taxa have ≥5 white and ≥5 nonwhite labelled photos in ≥2 eligible cells; 72 come from new_U100. The 55 excluding new_U100 have exploratory positive mean p=.010, median p=.095. Pooled all-1282 high-purity white mean loses support without new_U100 (p=.14). Do not infer a universal inherited white-flower cline or demographic history from these photographic labels.
